name: Hoe Tweaks
summary: Improves hoes: tilling covers a larger area that depends on hoe tier, right-clicking tilled soil reverts it to dirt, and melons and pumpkins break much faster with a hoe. Extra tilled blocks cost durability.

mechanics.title: Bigger tilling range
mechanics.description: While sneaking and right-clicking the center block (default): wooden 1x1, stone 3x3, gold 5x5, iron 5x5, diamond 7x7, netherite 9x9. Each extra block tilled damages the hoe, accounting for Unbreaking.

mechanics.title: Un-till
mechanics.description: Right-click tilled soil to turn it back to dirt; by default only works when the other hand is empty so you can still plant seeds.

mechanics.title: Faster crop blocks
mechanics.description: Pumpkins and melons break 8x faster with a hoe (cropBlockBreakSpeedModifier default 8.0).

vanilla_changes.change: Larger till area by tier, un-tilling, and faster melon/pumpkin breaking.

editor_notes: Values are mod defaults; no pack override found.
